description: Discover the rugged and reliable Toyota Hilux 2.8 GD-6 Raised Body Raider 4x4 Automatic Extended Cab, a perfect blend of strength and sophistication. Finished in a sleek white, this vehicle boasts a full service record and is in excellent condition, ready to tackle any adventure. Powered by a robust 130kW diesel engine, it offers a top speed of 180 km/h and features an automatic transmission for smooth driving. Inside, enjoy luxurious leather seats, a state-of-the-art Sat Nav compatible with Apple and Android devices, and a rear-view camera for added convenience. Safety is paramount with seven airbags, ABS, and park distance control. The Hilux comes equipped with a towbar, side steps, and a comprehensive set of extras including a Rhino front bumper, ToerTop, EFS shocks and coils, rubberised bed, Smash&Grab security, BF Goodrich tyres, stylish mags, hard Korr spotlights, a Tentco tent, and a diesel Jerry can, making it ideal for work or play.
